g.text: // Calculate position of thread within tile (Remapping from 1-D to 2-D)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: const uint ty = threadIdx.x / TILE_SIZE; // (0, TILE_SIZE-1)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: const uint tx = threadIdx.x % TILE_SIZE; // (0, TILE_SIZE-1)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: A += block_row * TILE_SIZE * N; // Move pointer (block_row * TILE_SIZE) rows down

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: A pointer moves to index 8 (1 * 2 * 4) -> Top left of the tile this block needs to load (A[2][0])

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: B += block_column * TILE_SIZE; // Move pointer (block_column * TILE_SIZE) columns
